notes: Box chosen in the eastern Mission flats and Potrero Ave (Bryant, York, Hampshire, Potrero, Utah, San Bruno, Vermont, from 22nd to 25th St, with San Francisco Hospital and the James Rolph Jr Playground). The bottom three rows (Kansas, Rhode Island, De Haro) are the lowest west slope of Potrero Hill near 23rd-25th; no other built-up ground on p09 or p11 stays clear of every listed area (p09 west is Bernal/Silver Terrace/Bayview, p09 south is Dogpatch beside Potrero Hill, p11 is Visitacion Valley/Portola/Bayview), and this is the part of p09 farthest from Potrero Hill north of 22nd and from Bernal. White (second residential) blocks with black (commercial) ends, cross-hatched (light industrial) and gridded (heavy industrial) blocks. HOW DRAWN: seeds; strokes about 2 px inside block outlines too faint for the paper threshold, which had let the street into the white paper of whole blocks while the seeds sat on the black ends (no error is printed for that): Hampshire block 3150-3345 x 647-722 (top and bottom), 3392-3523 x 953-1026 and 3392-3523 x 1056-1129, 3798-3974 x 740-813, 2990-3182 x 1259-1330 and 1359-1433 (whose bottom and top lines have real 10-35 px breaks near x 3027-3062, closed as if printed through), 3204-3351 x 1360-1433 (De Haro), the cross-hatched end of 3450-3559 x 550-625, the TWENTY-SECOND and TWENTY-THIRD label boxes at 3799-3816 x 645-722 and 3545-3560 x 1260-1331 (street names printed inside the ends of blocks), and the top Bryant-row block's bottom line (3366-3557 x 520, broken at 3522 and 3534-3540). The top row (y 487-523) holds the south ends of the Bryant St blocks, drawn open at the top where the sheet's drawing stops (about y 485): limits at y 489 close them (2950-3130, 3363-3562) and they are seeded as blocks. FOR THE OWNER TO RULE ON: (1) James Rolph Jr Playground (west edge, 2950-3050 x 745-855) is the land between the crop edge, the two diagonal lines and the top line; marked as its own block, parted from block 4276 by a stroke on the upper diagonal (2959,745)-(2997,793)-(3044,808)-(3050,818). (2) The strip 3080-3180 x 922-950 inside the gridded block, between the grid and the Starr King School lot, has no line on its east side and opens to the street: left as street (a dead end), as the fill made it; it may be part of the block. (3) The gridded block and the school lot (2950-3180 x 840-1030) are one area as printed. Unseeded islands left as street are outline ink outside the strokes (3350,1433; 3074,1433; 3072,1330; 3367,521; 3424,1027) and lettering. FIXED AFTER REVIEW: the street between blocks 4144 and 4143 (3818-3974 x 625-644) is closed on the west by the TWENTY-SECOND name strip lying across it and on the east by the crop edge; it was swallowed with both blocks by one seed. It now has its own street seed (3900,635), each block its own seed, and strokes on the two block edge lines across the name strip (y 624.5 and y 644, x 3797-3826) cut the lettering in the street off both blocks, so it is street; the strip's parts inside the block ends stay with their blocks. Checked the east column, bottom and west edges for other street stretches cut off by a name strip or the crop edge: none (the other name strips crossing streets, TWENTY-FIFTH, TWENTY-FOURTH, TWENTY-THIRD and the lower TWENTY-SECOND, cross streets that stay open at their other end).
